description: The goal of these buttons is to spark conversations. "Wow, you must be excited to vote for this person. How come?" "Fixing politics sounds like a lost cause. How do you think we can do that?" "What does the tyranny of the two-party system mean?" This campaign's advantage is that our electoral system is really in desperate need of reform, and we can tell people that we can make a better system at any time.
title: Campaign Button 1 | ImproveOurElections
